Tweet by @morganlinton (Morgan)
Author bio: CTO @BoldMetrics. Open source: @VulcanBench, @AlbatrossCoding. Giving back: https://t.co/yjmfmBSk1i, https://t.co/RJqKRqT51Z, https://t.co/DZZOGG8gbi.
Text: Workflows is one of the newest features in Grok Build and one I find still soooo many ppl don't know about.

Whenever I talk about how good Grok Build is at long running tasks people like to give me a hard time and say they already know it all.

Then I sure hope you know about workflows, because this is a monster feature.

Use /create-workflow to make them, then /workflows will give you a live dashboard to track them.

I use this for tasks that are too big for a single conversation, like, "review every feature in this PR" or "triage the last 100 issues" and then I just let it jam.

A lot of people don't realize how powerful this is on the orchestration side, it's really powerful.
